name: Alex Webb
career_history: Sales Director - New Business at Stellanor Datacentres, 5/2026 to present; Sales Director - Retail at Redcentric Data Centres, 9/2024 to present; Head of SME at Redcentric, 9/2023 to 8/2024; Head of New Business at Redcentric, 9/2022 to 9/2023; Head of Sales at 4D Data Centres, 12/2018 to 9/2022; Business Development Team Leader at 4D Data Centres, 5/2012 to 11/2018; Team Leader at JD Wetherspoon, 3/2009 to 3/2013
education: Bachelor of Photography, University for the Creative Arts, 2008 to 2011
biography: Do these problems relate? 1) Businesses rapid growth meant we built our infrastructure in "The Cloud", but now we are finding the cost unbearable for our heavier workloads. 2) Our data centres (in-house or external) are not fit for their purpose. We have an office move/hardware refresh/outages compelling us to make changes. 3) We are on a digital transformation journey, but some applications just won't fit in the cloud. If so, 'Connect'. For nearly ten years, I have been helping IT leaders implement their strategy with an infrastructure foundation they can trust. Through data centre hosting, colocation, IaaS (Private, Hybrid and Public), connectivity and cyber-security to protect it. While the cloud is for everyone, it is not for everything. I help make the right IT choices for your business.
